rider.title: My settings
rider.intro: Your weight, position and reference power make speed and resistance more accurate. Difficulty softens the climbs for beginners or lower-powered trainers.
rider.privacyAccount: Your weight and these settings are personal data: they are saved on your account, on a server in Switzerland, so you find them on every device. They are only used to work out your speed and the resistance, are visible to you alone and are shared with nobody. You can delete them at any time.

rider.weightHelp: With your kit. The heavier you are, the harder the climbs.
rider.bikeHelp: A road bike weighs 8 to 10 kg.
rider.positionHelp: The lower you are, the less the air slows you down: it matters most on the flat and downhill.
rider.ftpHelp: The power you can hold for about an hour. If you do not know it: 95 % of your best 20-minute average.

rider.difficultyHelp: At 100 % you ride the real grade. At 50 %, an 8 % climb pedals like a 4 % one, and you move accordingly. Ideal to start or for a lower-powered trainer. The terrain you see stays the course's.

privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.intro: This is what Vaud Ride keeps about you, why, and how to delete it. The app follows the Swiss data protection act (nLPD / FADP). Without an account nothing is sent: your settings stay on your device.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Your nickname, your e-mail address and your password (kept in an encrypted form that cannot be read back). The nickname shows in the leaderboards and to the other riders on the same course; the e-mail address is never shown.

rides.title: Your rides
rides.text: Only when you choose to save them: the course, the date, the duration, the distance, the climb and, second by second, power, cadence and heart rate. They are visible to you alone. Only your times on segments (with your nickname) appear in the leaderboards.

settings.title: Your settings, including your weight
settings.text: Rider and bike weight, position, FTP and difficulty. Weight is sensitive personal data: it is only used to work out your speed and the resistance, is never displayed or shared, and is not in your public profile. Signed in, your settings are saved on your account so you find them on every device; signed out, they stay on your device. You can delete them at any time from the "My settings" page.

live.title: During a ride
live.text: Your nickname, your position on the course and your power are shown live to the other riders on the same course. This is not kept.

extras.title: Kit, favourites and Strava
extras.text: The colours of your kit, the places you favourite and, if you connect Strava, the authorisation needed to send your rides there. You can disconnect Strava at any time.

origin.title: What is not kept
origin.text: The app does not record your country or where you live. The usage statistics shown to those in charge of the service are anonymous totals: for example, how many times a course's GPX was taken or a public-transport link opened, counted with no identifier and no address.

hosting.title: Where the data is
hosting.text: The server and the database holding this information are hosted in Switzerland.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data. You delete your settings (weight included) yourself from the "My settings" page; for the rest, write to us.
